visual.name: atlasDistribution
visual.description: Histogram, box and whisker, violin and raincloud, and parallel coordinates in one visual, with flat, soft and 3D looks and a palette that follows your report theme, a brand color or your own colors.

en-US.Role_Group_Desc: Optional. One box, violin or histogram color per value, for example Carrier or Channel.
en-US.Role_Detail_Desc: The field that identifies one observation, for example Order ID or Shipment ID. Each row becomes one data point.
en-US.Role_Values_Desc: The value to describe. Parallel coordinates draws one axis per measure.
en-US.Landing_Line1: Add a measure to Values and the field that identifies one observation (Order ID, Shipment ID) to Sample by.
en-US.Landing_Line2: Add a Group to compare distributions. Pick histogram, box, violin or parallel coordinates in the Format pane.
en-US.Need_Two: Parallel coordinates needs two or more measures in Values.
en-US.Warn_Limit_Text: There are more observations than the visual can show. Filter the report to see a complete distribution.
en-US.Mark_Selected: Selected: this visual is filtering other visuals
en-US.Mark_Filter: This visual is filtering the report
en-US.Mark_Highlighted: Highlighted by a selection in another visual
